heading: Fact model — schema dedup constraint
text:
### Fact model — schema dedup constraint [LNLS.4.7]

Overlays retract-and-replace ([LFAC.1.2.2]).

Under `linear_scan: false` the engine **must** find the fact an assertion supersedes in
O(1) amortized, for every `logical` schema. No further constraint on the
schema is needed: the lookup reads the declared key ([LFAC.1.7.5]), and a
schema whose key is empty holds at most one live fact ([LFAC.1.7.2]).
`tolerance` does not enter it, because a tolerance is admissible only on a
`mutable` slot, never a `key` slot ([LFAC.1.7.1]).

**Removal is O(1) amortized as well.** Under `linear_scan: false` the engine **must** remove
a fact from working memory in O(1) amortized in the live facts of its schema,
whatever removes it: the supersedure above, a retraction, a withdrawal or an
expiry. The bound covers every structure the removal itself updates, not only
the indexes over live facts: bookkeeping a rule keeps per fact, such as the
facts a rule has already fired on, and the release of the values the fact
held. Two terms are outside the bound. A fact with a deadline also leaves
`dynamic_ttl`'s deadline heap, at the O(log N_ttl) [LDTL.1.2] states. A
`TimeZoneOffset` fact also leaves its zone's index ([LTIM.10.7]), at O(log r)
in the live facts of that zone.
What the removal sets off downstream is bounded where it is stated: the beta
joins by [LNLS.5.1], and each fact a cascade removes by this clause.
